item.title: Probe into Manipur twin blasts handed over to NIA
item.description: IMPHAL: The investigation into the twin blasts in Manipur’s Bishnupur district was handed over to the NIA, officials said on Tuesday. Two persons were injured in the consecutive explosions that rocked Ngaukon in the Phougakchao police station area on Monday morning, they said.
